sloka: नानागंधर्वमिथुनैर्पानसंसर्गकर्कशैः ।उत्पतद्भिर्विहंगैश्चविद्याधरगणैरपि - यद्वा -नाना गन्धर्व मिथुनैः पान संसर्ग कर्कशैः ।उत् पतद्भिः विहंगैः च विद्याधर गणैः अपि ॥४-६७-४५॥
transliteration: nānāgaṁdharvamithunairpānasaṁsargakarkaśaiḥ ।utpatadbhirvihaṁgaiścavidyādharagaṇairapi - yadvā -nānā gandharva mithunaiḥ pāna saṁsarga karkaśaiḥ ।ut patadbhiḥ vihaṁgaiḥ ca vidyādhara gaṇaiḥ api ॥4-67-45॥

translations.english: The rocks of the mountain got scattered by the force. The deer and elephants were terrified. The trees were shaken up violently and streams of water gushed forth.
